explication: Sn1per is a command-line offensive-security platform: an operator selects a scan mode, the engine coordinates reconnaissance and security checks, and results are collected for review and reporting. The repository tree shows the engine, mode scripts, configuration profiles, detection templates, and utility scripts; the README documents recon, vulnerability scanning, exploitation, and reporting as core capabilities. Professional UI, workspace, and API features are edition claims, not represented by an identifiable implementation in this Community Edition tree. Some links reflect documented behavior because the main engine source was not sampled.
